Getting Started

Set up Graf in your project in under 5 minutes. Graf needs Node.js 22.5 or newer.

1
Download Graf

Get the command-line tool, and the extension if you use VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf.

Download CLI (.zip)Download extension (.vsix)
2
Install

Unzip, open a terminal in the graf folder, and run the installer.

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install-windows.ps1
bash install-unix.sh

Extension: code --install-extension graf-local.graf-project-graph-0.2.0.vsix

3
Initialize a project

Run this in your project directory.

graf init
4
Connect an AI client

Claude Code, from inside your project:

claude mcp add graf -- graf serve

Claude Desktop, Cursor and Windsurf: add this to your MCP settings.

{ "mcpServers": { "graf": { "command": "graf", "args": ["serve"] } } }

CLI Usage

graf initInitialize and index a project
graf syncIncrementally update the graph
graf statusShow graph freshness and counts
graf overviewPrint the project digest
graf search <query>Search graph nodes
graf note <text>Add a human note
graf snapshot [label]Create a version snapshot
graf diff <version>Compare the current graph with a version
graf restore <version>Restore a version (history is kept)
graf serveRun the MCP server with live sync
